information: **Please read all the above tabs before registering.** * **Please attempt to limit your guests to one guest per competitor, as the venue is small.** * **If you have registered and are no longer able to attend, please email the organizers to cancel your registration.** - Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age. - Proceeds from this competition will go toward Cube New England and the [Campaign for Southern Equality](https://southernequality.org/styep/#:~:text=Through%2520STYEP%252C%2520and%2520in%2520close,the%2520face%2520of%2520oppressive%2520laws.).
